purpose: Select the smallest sufficient set of learned capabilities from task evidence while preserving independent authority gates.

contract.learned_capability_admission: A learned capability is model-reachable by default only after it has an owner, trigger evidence, negative trigger, cost class, authority boundary, verification rule, and pressure-test evidence.
contract.unknown_handling: Return a bounded StartWork or recommendation instead of guessing a risky capability.
contract.explicit_operation_precedence: An explicit operation remains the operation decision; autonomous capability selection may add read-only preparation or verification but may not replace it.

decision_classes.meaning: The model may select the capability as a bounded plan or registered low-risk functional unit.
The Agent may identify the capability but waits for a consequential human choice.
The capability can be selected, but its side effect remains with the named owner gate.
The capability must never be autonomously activated from observed capability or intent labels.

capabilities.activation: retrieve only relevant durable context; never inject the whole memory store
capabilities.verification: relevance note or explicit skip reason

capabilities.activation: compose explicit role, input, output, acceptance, and boundary contracts; delegation remains separately gated
capabilities.gate: registered owner route and child-agent contract
capabilities.verification: selected owner set and acceptance criteria are recorded

capabilities.activation: derive a bounded design-only profile from verified local or source evidence; do not register a new top-level owner
capabilities.verification: profile-fit, functional effect, owner alignment, and authority boundary evidence

capabilities.activation: ground the source, extract reusable method, pressure-test triggers, and adapt under an existing owner
capabilities.gate: source and owner verification; installation and publication remain independently gated
capabilities.verification: pinned source, evidence map, adapted contract, and regression test

capabilities.activation: produce bounded alternatives and a decision-ready recommendation; stop when the decision is clear
capabilities.gate: none for analysis; selected implementation still follows owner gates
capabilities.verification: alternatives, criteria, recommendation, and unresolved decision are explicit

capabilities.activation: select durable goals, todos, lease, quota, and continuation evidence only when the task is genuinely long-running
capabilities.gate: LoopX control-plane policy; never credentials, publication, destructive work, production writes, or owner-gated actions
capabilities.verification: goal/todo ownership, bounded continuation, quota decision, and settled save point

capabilities.activation: select the narrowest proving check and require evidence before claiming completion
capabilities.gate: format, Git, release, visual, and owner gates remain independent
capabilities.verification: test or rendered evidence plus residual-risk statement

capabilities.activation: prepare a redacted candidate and write back only after verification and duplicate checks
capabilities.gate: experience-capture and memory authority; private material is excluded
capabilities.verification: source, trigger, action, verification, scope, invalidation, and status are recorded

conflict_policy.simple_task_floor: Do not select expert-contract-mode, brainstorming-lite, or loopx-control-plane for a one-line or typo-only task.
conflict_policy.high_risk_override: evidence-review-mode may be selected, but it never authorizes the high-risk action being reviewed.
conflict_policy.multiple_capabilities: Select multiple capabilities only when their evidence is independent and the combined plan reduces user effort without hiding a gate.

pressure_tests: external source learning selects methodology-distillation without installation
missing expert template selects expert-template-synthesis as design-only
long-running continuation selects loopx-control-plane without authority expansion
one-line edit selects no broad planning capability
credential or destructive wording never becomes autonomous execution
invalidation_conditions: a repeated false positive causes unnecessary context or tool work
a learned capability lacks a maintained owner or verifier
a deferred capability hides an approval gate
the runtime plan can be mistaken for permission
